what: stderr of `ffmpeg -hide_banner -i <file>`, the exact command ClipShuttle's probeStreams runs
ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 6.0 Copyright (c) 2000-2023 the FFmpeg developers
ffmpegSource: the ffmpeg binary ClipShuttle installs into its CEP extension folder
clips: 1 s synthetic clips: lavfi testsrc2 320x180 at 25 fps plus a 440 Hz sine, encoded as listed

recordings.label: AV1 in .mp4
recordings.encode: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25:duration=1 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=1 -c:v libaom-av1 -cpu-used 8 -row-mt 1 -b:v 200k -c:a aac -shortest av1.mp4

recordings.label: VP9 in .webm
recordings.encode: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25:duration=1 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=1 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -deadline realtime -b:v 200k -c:a libopus -shortest vp9.webm

recordings.label: H.264 yuv420p10le in .mp4
recordings.encode: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25:duration=1 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=1 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p10le -preset ultrafast -c:a aac -shortest h264-10bit.mp4

recordings.label: H.264 + AAC, 8-bit, in .mp4
recordings.encode: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=25:duration=1 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=1 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -preset ultrafast -c:a aac -shortest h264-aac.mp4
